summary: A value that becomes a field where it stands — an agent's purpose under its name, a row's label. The value is text with an Edit button beside it; editing shows the field with Save and Cancel. Enter saves, Escape cancels, focus goes in and comes back, and a failed or invalid save keeps what was typed.
useWhen: one value on a page that is read far more often than it is changed — a name, a description, a label
changing it should not take the user to a settings page or a dialog

useInstead.when: several values are changed and saved together
useInstead.why: a form with one Save is clearer than several editors each saving on their own

useInstead.when: the change needs a warning or a second look — deleting, transferring ownership
useInstead.why: an inline Save is one keystroke; a consequential change deserves a confirmation

useInstead.when: a switch that applies at once
useInstead.why: there is nothing to type, so there is nothing to save or cancel

composition.note: `label` is required: it names the field and the Edit button. Pass `value` and `onSave` to keep the value yourself; return a promise from `onSave` and throw to report a failure. `validate` runs before `onSave`. `placeholder` stands in for an empty value — "Add a purpose". `isMultiline` makes it a Textarea: Enter adds a line and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter saves.
composition.example: <InlineEdit label="Purpose" editLabel="Edit purpose" value={purpose} onSave={savePurpose} validate={(v) => (v.trim() ? undefined : 'Say what the agent is for.')} />

md.use: the default — a medium field, beside body text

sm.use: a small field, in a dense row or a table cell

requires: `label` — the name of the value, translated
`editLabel` when "Edit" plus the label does not read naturally — "Edit purpose", not "Edit Purpose"
guarantees: the value is plain text, read as text; the Edit button is one tab stop beside it
opening the editor focuses the field with its text selected
Save and Cancel return focus to the Edit button
Escape cancels from the field or either button, and does not reach a dialog around it
an invalid value or a failed save keeps the editor open, with the message as the field's error and what was typed kept
while saving, the field is read-only and Save says Saving… — nothing is disabled, so focus stays put
a save is announced in a status region that is always mounted
notes: saving an unchanged value just closes the editor, without calling `onSave`
nothing happens on blur: leaving the field does not save or throw away what was typed
the value inherits the text around it — a page description, a table cell — so it looks like the text it replaces; `size` is the field's

antiPatterns.why: a value that is itself the button is announced as a button, and a sighted user has no sign it can be edited

antiPatterns.do: Save and Cancel, with Enter and Escape
antiPatterns.why: tabbing away to check something commits a half-typed value
